{{Current events|year=2025|month=12|day=7|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 Beninese coup attempt]]
**Elements of the [[Benin Armed Forces]], led by [[Pascal Tigri]], announce a [[coup d'état]] against [[President of Benin|president]] [[Patrice Talon]] and the creation of a [[military junta]], the Military Committee for Refoundation, after seizing [[Bénin TV|state television]]. The coup attempt is ultimately unsuccessful. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/7/soldiers-appear-on-benin-state-television-announcing-apparent-coup (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[Nigerian Air Force]] launches precision [[airstrike]]s against pro-coup forces in [[Cotonou]] in support of the [[Politics of Benin|Beninese government]], killing several putschists. [https://saharareporters.com/2025/12/07/nigerian-air-force-launches-precision-airstrikes-fleeing-benin-republic-coup-plotters (Sahara Reporters)] [https://zagazola.org/index.php/breaking-news/nigerian-air-force-conducts-multiple-precision-airstrikes-on-fleeing-coup-plotters-in-benin-republic (Zagazola)]
**[[ECOWAS]] announces the deployment of ground troops to Benin from [[Ghana]], [[Ivory Coast]], [[Nigeria]], and [[Sierra Leone]]. [https://saharareporters.com/2025/12/07/ecowas-deploys-immediate-standby-force-benin-after-failed-coup-attempt (Sahara Reporters)]
**[[France]] provides [[military intelligence]], [[surveillance aircraft]], and logistical assistance to Benin and shares intelligence with Nigeria to help thwart the coup attempt. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/france-provided-logistical-support-benin-thwart-coup-elysee-says-2025-12-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Ditwah]]
***The death toll from the floods and [[landslide]]s caused by heavy rains in [[Sri Lanka]] increases to 618. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/7/sri-lanka-landslides-feared-as-toll-hits-618-widespread-loss-sweeps-asia (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Cyclone Senyar]]
***The death toll from the [[flood]]s in [[Indonesia]] increases to 908, while 410 people remain missing. In [[Thailand]], at least 216 people are also confirmed killed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/6/heavy-rains-hamper-recovery-as-death-toll-from-floods-in-asia-exceeds-1750 (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[Fire and Rescue New South Wales|Fire and Rescue NSW]] [[firefighter]] is killed and dozens of homes are destroyed as [[Bushfires in Australia|bushfires]] spread across parts of [[New South Wales]] and [[Tasmania]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/australian-firefighter-killed-bushfires-destroy-homes-two-states-2025-12-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Papiri kidnapping]]
**[[Nigeria]]n authorities secure the release of 100 of the 315 students and staff [[Kidnapping in Nigeria|abducted]] from a school in [[Niger State]], while more than 160 others remain unaccounted for. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/dec/07/release-secured-of-100-kidnapped-nigerian-schoolchildren-but-many-still-being-held (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**Thirteen suspected [[Los Lobos (gang)|Los Lobos]] gang members are killed in a [[prison riot]] following two explosions in [[Machala]], [[El Oro Province]], Ecuador. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/12/death-toll-rises-to-13-in-riot-at-ecuadors-machala-prison/ (BNO News)] [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-prison-clashes-inmates-killed-d68975c31a4b291f91dc795ff814633b (AP)]
*[[Brazil]]ian [[Federal Police of Brazil|police]] report that two armed individuals [[Art theft|stole]] eight [[Henri Matisse]] [[engraving]]s and five works by [[Candido Portinari]] from the [[Mário de Andrade Library]] in [[São Paulo]] after threatening a security guard and visitors. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251207-eight-matisse-engravings-stolen-from-brazil-library (AFP via France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Hong Kong legislative election]]
**[[Hong Kong]] citizens vote for the members of the [[Legislative Council of Hong Kong|Legislative Council]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/hong-kong-election-turnout-focus-amid-anger-over-deadly-fire-2025-12-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 FIFA Futsal Women's World Cup]]
**In [[futsal]], [[Brazil women's national futsal team|Brazil]] wins the inaugural [[FIFA Futsal Women's World Cup]] after defeating [[Portugal women's national futsal team|Portugal]] 3–0 in the final held in [[Metro Manila]], [[Philippines]]. [[Emilly]] is awarded the tournament's [[Golden Ball (FIFA World Cup)|Golden Ball]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/sports/football/968768/brazil-beats-portugal-to-take-home-first-ever-fifa-futsal-women-s-world-cup-title/story/ (GMA News)]
*[[2025 Formula One World Championship]]
**In [[auto racing]], [[McLaren]]'s [[Lando Norris]] wins his first [[Formula One]] [[List of Formula One World Drivers' Champions|World Drivers' Championship]] after outscoring the [[2024 Formula One World Championship|defending champion]], [[Red Bull Racing|Red Bull]]'s [[Max Verstappen]], by two points at the end of the season's [[2025 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix|final race]] in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/formula1/articles/czrk61y2nyjo (BBC)]
